entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return an item. I'm looking at my order number, it's VF-8675309. I've had it with this company's terrible service.

I'm very sorry to hear that you're not satisfied. I can certainly look into that order for you. I see it's for the AeroFlow helmet. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

A preference? I don't have time for 20 questions! The color is completely wrong. It looks nothing like the picture online. I'm not putting a helmet on my head if the color is off. It's a matter of principle. And for what I paid, it should be perfect.

I completely understand your frustration when an item doesn't meet your expectations. I see here that your order was delivered 48 days ago. Just to confirm, the item is still in its original condition?

Forty-eight days? So what? Are you trying to get out of this? The box is unopened! I took one look at the color through the plastic and knew it was wrong. This is ridiculous. I want to talk to your manager, right now. I'm a VIP member and I will be leaving a review about this on every website I can find.

There's no need for that, sir, I can resolve this for you directly. I was just confirming the details. Our standard return policy is actually 90 days, so you are well within the window for a full refund. There's absolutely no problem with processing this return.
Oh. Well... it should be. Why did you even bring up the date then?

It's just a required verification step on my end, and I do sincerely apologize if my question caused any alarm. I've just initiated the return in our system. You'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label within the next five minutes. Simply attach it to the package and drop it off.
Fine. Make sure the refund is processed quickly.

Of course. And for the trouble and the mix-up with the color, I'd like to offer you a 25% discount code for your next purchase. We want to make sure you get the gear that's right for you. Your safety and satisfaction are our top priorities at VeloFit.
A 25% discount? Alright. That's better. Fine. Just send me the email with the label and the code. Thank you.
I've already sent it. It should be in your inbox now. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
